pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **You're All Playing Soccer Monopoly, and Gunner's the Only One Who Bought Boardwalk.** Let's face it, Gunner's sitting pretty at the top because he drafted with a brain, unlike the rest of these newbies wandering around like they stumbled into a FIFA simulation. Look at Devin over there, "Ghost Pepper," thinking he's spicy by matching Spain against Brazil. Don't make me laugh—Spain's midfield isn't scaring anyone these days, and Brazil will casually roll through Norway like it's a training session. Rafe, "The Noisemaker," is an absolute circus act. Drafting three squads that aren't even in the tournament? It's like he's picked them from thin air while blindfolded. Meanwhile, Gayden, the "Backpass Assassin," is about to watch Mexico out-hustle the Three Lions in Mexico City, not that he'd know—he's too busy trying to make sure Jordan is ready for glory. At the end of the day, this is a joke. Gunner’s running circles around these guys, accumulating points while the rest pretend they’ve got a clue.
